headline: Zwolle won the derby 4-1, lost their coach, and now go to Utrecht
summary: PEC Zwolle won the IJsselderby 4-1 against Go Ahead Eagles on Sunday, then sacked head coach Henry van der Vegt this week. No successor is in place for the trip to Utrecht, who won 2-1 at Twente — Twente's first home defeat of the season. The market makes Utrecht 56.3% favourites. Zwolle have conceded 14 goals in their last 5 league games and lost 6 of their 9, yet the handicap still gives them a 0.75-goal head start: a narrow home win. The total line is 3.25 goals and over is only 47.3%.
read: PEC Zwolle arrive in Utrecht without a manager, two days after sacking Henry van der Vegt, but also with a 4-1 derby win behind them. Utrecht have won two in a row, including 2-1 at Twente, and the market makes them clear favourites — about 0.8 goals the better side with a total-goals line of 3.25.

facts.fact: PEC Zwolle sacked head coach Henry van der Vegt two days ago and are still searching for a successor.
facts.meaning: Zwolle come to Utrecht with the coaching situation unresolved, days after their best result of the season.

facts.fact: Utrecht won 2-1 away at Twente on Sunday — Twente's first home defeat of the season.
facts.meaning: A third win in four league games for Utrecht, who started the season badly and are now building.

facts.fact: Utrecht are 56.3% to win at home — more than twice Zwolle's 21.2%.
facts.meaning: Clear home favourites, but with the draw at 22.5% the market does not treat it as a formality.

facts.fact: Zwolle won the IJsselderby 4-1 against Go Ahead Eagles on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They arrive with something to build on after three straight defeats — a caretaker lift is possible.

facts.fact: The market rates Utrecht about 0.8 goals better than Zwolle, with the main handicap line at -0.75.
facts.meaning: A one-goal Utrecht win only pays half on the -0.75 line: the market sees a narrow home win, not a rout.

facts.fact: Zwolle have conceded 14 goals across their last five league matches.
facts.meaning: Almost three per game, so Utrecht should get chances even without playing well.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 3.25 and Over is priced at 47.3%.
facts.meaning: The market leans just under three and a quarter goals — an open game, but not a shoot-out.

facts.fact: Utrecht are unbeaten in the last five meetings with Zwolle, winning three of them.
facts.meaning: Zwolle have not beaten Utrecht since 2023, home or away.

sources.fact: FC Utrecht won 1-2 away at FC Twente, handing Twente their first home defeat of the season.
Coach Anthony Correia called Utrecht his 'Ultimate Team' and said the side is growing, after the win at Twente.
Goalkeeper Padt said 'something is really growing' at Utrecht after seeing players make sliding tackles, block shots and stick to the plan against Twente.
Nordin Amrabat, 39, became the oldest outfield player in an FC Utrecht shirt in the win at Twente.
Utrecht go into the Zwolle game after recent wins over Willem II and FC Twente, following a difficult start.
A win against PEC Zwolle on Saturday would continue Utrecht's good run and take them to twelve points.
PEC Zwolle sacked coach Henry van der Vegt and are still searching for a new head coach.
PEC Zwolle won the IJsselderby, beating Go Ahead Eagles 4-1 after a strong second half, following a deep slump.
